answer: Neighbor-quorum bonds stop bulk fake identities. A newcomer needs five quill signatures. Signatures sit on a public atlas, exposing a rented-neighbor ring. Each signer stakes a 20-credit ember; a fake burns the five stakes and its 70-credit bond, 170 per fake. Each neighbor vouches for at most three per epoch, so 1,000 fakes need 1,667 neighbors, costing 170,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay once, keep the bond after a clean epoch.
